question: The kinetic energy possessed by a body of mass 2 kg is 100 J. The velocity of the body will be:
solution:
**Concept:**

 

**Principle of Conservation of Energy:**

 

 
• The principle states that energy cannot be created or destroyed, only transformed from one form to another.
 
• In the context of this problem, the potential energy (PE) at the maximum height will be equal to the initial kinetic energy (KE).

**Important terms:**

 
• **Potential Energy (PE):** Energy possessed by a body due to its position or height.

 SI Unit: Joule (J)

 Dimensional Formula: [M L2 T-2]

 
• **Kinetic Energy (KE):** Energy possessed by a body due to its motion.

 SI Unit: Joule (J)

 Dimensional Formula: [M L2 T-2]

 

**Calculation:**

 

**Given:**

Mass of the ball (m) = 2 kg

Kinetic energy (KE) = 100 J

We know,

Kinetic Energy = 1/2 mv²

⇒ 100 = 1/2 × 2 × v²

⇒ 100 = v²

⇒ v = √100 = 10 m/s

**∴ The velocity of the body will be 10 m/s.**
